data.summary:
Provide excellence in laid down targets of the company in stipulated time through teamwork, innovation, honesty, and using my gracious skills for learning new creative ideas which will be useful for the growth of company and self.
 Name of the Organization: Northern Trust Operating Services  Work Experience: 04Th July 2023 to Present  Designation: Senior Analyst (Private equity fund accounting)
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITY
Managed accounting and financial reporting activities for Private Equity funds, including General Partner (GP) and Limited Partner (LP) entities. Booking and reconciling Unit dealings against TA report. Processed capital calls, investor contributions, distributions, and transfer transactions while maintaining accurate LP investor records Reconciled investment activity, cash balances, capital accounts, and partner balances to ensure completeness and
accuracy of fund records.
Calculated and validated Net Asset Value (NAV) for private equity funds, ensuring accuracy and timely reporting.
• Monitored management fees, carried interest calculations, and partnership allocations. •
Reviewed trial balances, general ledger entries, accruals, and month-end close activities. Collaborated with investment managers, custodians, administrators, and legal teams on fund operations and reporting.
• Assisted in the preparation and review of waterfall calculations to ensure accurate allocation of distributions between GP and LP investors in accordance with fund agreements.
 Name of the Organization: State Street HCL Services  Work Experience: Sep. 2022 to Jun 2023  Designation: Specialist (Custody Income – Migration Hyderabad to Pune)
Migration of Process Custody Income. • Attending Onshore Calls Trainings from State Street Hyderabad to Pune. • Rasing terminal access and solving the queries of Preparer. Recording the training sessions on daily basis and shares to all partners.
➢ Name of the organization: Genpact India Pvt ltd
 Work Experience: Jun 2021 to Aug 2022
 Designation: Senior associate
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITY:
•
Prepare position reconciliation by re searching all out stages comparison of internal accounting system as well as with the position held at the fund. Prepare and review holding reconciliation to recon position, prices, market value and accrued income.
•
Calculating monthly, quarterly, and yearly performances of client portfolio which content various capital market investments likes Stocks, Bonds, Mutual funds and other investment vehicles and provide timely delivery of performance data to Client.
Reconciling for cash and position between clients and its Custodian on instruction
Checking daily emails and mailing communication with Client regarding missing statement and timeline to overcome expected loss
WORK EXCPERIENCE
 Name of the organization: State Street Syntel Services Pvt Ltd, Pune Process - Fund Accounting (Corporate Action and Trade Review)
 Work Experience: Jan 2019 - Jun 2021  Designation: Associate
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITY
Review and verify all types of trades likes Equity, Bond, Swaps, options, FX and Future on Bloomberg and accounting system.
Checks NAV (Net asset value) and percentage change on buy and sale trade for Client on daily basis. Verifying
• Verifying the trades with Bloomberg, KSAF, WMT, IDC and CVC(Cross vendor comparison) • Escalating incorrect trades on time to avoid NAV error Coordinating with other team to publish NAV accurately.
• Validating trades with valid backup and maintaining backup for audit purpose. • • Daily run the cart report and check all corporate action trades provided by Client and review with Client report. • • Manage the team in the absence of team member in order that all deadline are met in an efficient manner • Hands on experience in daily Checklist. Reconcile the rates and the position of the share holders offered by company.
Sound knowledge of corporate action, mutual fund, investment banking, debts market, derivative.
